title: Mnemonic Body-Artifact 3D Separation

availability.meaning: The scene contract, example, and executable validator are implemented. A production body rig, garment solver, and rendering runtime are not yet claimed.
must_not_claim: Do not claim a full mnemonic reconstruction runtime from this contract alone.
Do not claim cloth simulation, a production character rig, or recipient-tested delivery unless separate evidence exists.
Do not flatten conflicting body and artifact evidence into one canonical scene.

acceptance: Body and garment object identifiers are disjoint.
Every major object has provenance and confidence.
Interactions reference existing body and artifact objects.
At least one unresolved or alternative hypothesis is preserved when conflicts exist.
The scene declares reopen and reuse checks for pose, garment state, or camera variation.
next_runtime_gate: produce a skinned body asset and detachable garment asset
execute one body motion with independent garment response
reopen the retained scene and render a second camera view
emit a completion receipt using the command-center evidence schema
